title: ICC Docket 25-1102 — Order - Final: Final Order
text:

ORDER 

By the Commission: 
I. 
INTRODUCTION 
On December 30, 2025, Under the Sun Solar Limited (“Applicant”) filed a verified 
Application with the Illinois Commerce Commission (“Commission”) requesting a 
certificate of service authority to operate as an installer of energy efficiency measures in 
Illinois pursuant to Section 16 128B of the Public Utilities Act (“Act”). 220 ILCS 5/16-
128B. On February 25, 2026, the Administrative Law Judge (“ALJ”) issued a ruling 
directing Applicant to revise the certificate of insurance to list the Illinois Commerce 
Commission as a certificate holder. Applicant did not file any response to the ruling. A 
Proposed Order was issued on April 27, 2026. No briefs on exceptions were filed. 
II. 
THE APPLICATION 
Part 462 of the Commission’s rules sets forth requirements for applicants seeking 
a certificate of authority to install energy efficiency measures in the State of Illinois. 83 
Ill. Adm. Code 462. The information provided in the Application is not sufficient to show 
that the Applicant meets the requirements to be approved as an installer of energy 
efficiency measures in Illinois. Section 462.50 of the Commission’s rules requires 
Applicants to be licensed to do business in Illinois. The Administrative Law Judge issued 
a ruling directing Applicant to update the certificate of insurance on February 25, 2026. 
Applicant did not respond to the ruling and did not respond to the Proposed Order issued 
by the ALJ on April 27, 2026. 
III. 
COMMISSION ANALYSIS AND CONCLUSION 
The Commission reviewed the Application and attachments provided by the 
Applicant and finds that the Applicant did not demonstrate compliance with the 
requirements of the Act and Part 462 of the Commission’s rules. The Commission finds 
that Applicant has failed to meet the requirements necessary to justify recommendation 
for a certificate of authority to install energy efficiency measures in the State of Illinois 
under the Act and Part 462 of the Commission’s rules. The Commission therefore 
concludes that the Applicant’s request for a certificate of authority to install energy 
efficiency measures in Illinois should be denied.

IV. 
FINDINGS AND ORDERING PARAGRAPHS 

The Commission, having reviewed the entire record, is of the opinion and finds 
that: 
(1) 
Under the Sun Solar Limited seeks a certificate of service authority to 
operate as an Installer of Energy Efficiency Measures under Section 16-
128A of the Act; 
(2) 
the Commission has jurisdiction over the party hereto and the subject matter 
hereof; 
(3) 
the recitals of fact and conclusions reached in the prefatory portion of this 
Order are supported by the record and are hereby adopted as findings of 
fact; 
(4) 
Under the Sun Solar Limited has not complied with Section 16-128A of the 
Public Utilities Act and Part 462 of the Commission’s rules; and 
(5) 
Under the Sun Solar Limited should not be granted a certificate of service 
authority to operate as an Installer of Energy Efficiency Measures in the 
State of Illinois as specified in this Order. 
IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED by the Illinois Commerce Commission that Under 
the Sun Solar Limited is hereby denied a Certificate of Service Authority authorizing it to 
operate as an Installer of Energy Efficiency Measures in the State of Illinois. 
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that pursuant to Section 10-113(a) of the Public 
Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, any application for rehearing shall be filed 
within 30 days after service of the Order on the party. 
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that, subject to the provisions of Section 10-113 of the 
Public Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, this Order is final; it is not subject to 
the Administrative Review Law. 
By Order of the Commission this 1st day of July, 2026. 

(SIGNED) DOUGLAS P. SCOTT 

Chairman
